newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul to ease controls on foreign loans from Oct.
newsitem.headline: Seoul to ease controls on foreign loans from Oct.

text.p: South Korea will allow small and medium-sized firms in the non-manufacturing sectors to acquire foreign loans, effective from October 1, the Finance and Economy Ministry said on Thursday.
As planned earlier, all small and medium-sized firms except those involved in the entertainment industry can receive foreign loans for facility imports, a ministry official said.

The ministry will allow introduction of foreign loans with interest of up to two basis points above the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), compared to up to one basis point above LIBOR at present, he said.
